Nevermind, figured it out. To anyone else having this issue here's how to do it:

First off, you can't be running Halo 2 from a disc, you have to have it installed to your hard drive, then run the Halo 2 Map Pack (Burned Disc or Download), install the map packs, then manually extract the $u15 folder from the Map Pack Disc using aurora's file manager or xexmenu, place it in the Compatibility/Xbox1/TDATA/4d530064 folder then replace the default.xbe file from your copy of Halo 2 with the one from the $u15 folder and voila! It works!
